panes.title: Current session trace
panes.source:
(load-lain "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

(define input 4)
(def-cells result traced)

(-> (+ input 1) result)

; trace reads this pane's current runtime-session graph.
(trace:session result :both traced)

(display traced)

panes.title: Live clock history
panes.source:
(load-primitive-environment
  "extensions/runtime_clock.clj"
  :extensions.runtime-clock/primitive-bindings)

(load-lain
  "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

; The runtime publishes a new event value every 500 ms.
(define time
  (clock-in 500))

(display
  (trace:history time 0 60000))

panes.title: Potential and realized calls
panes.source:
(load-lain "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/tracers.lain")

(define shift
  (network [x]
    (+ x 1)))

(define square
  (network [x]
    (* x x)))

(define pipeline
  (network [x]
    (square (shift x))))

; Realize the pipeline once so the graph contains both declared call sites
; and the applications connected by this execution.
; Datalog derives calls/called-by relationships and connects each closure and
; realized call frame to the shared central lexical environment.
(define result
  (pipeline 4))

(display
  (trace:calls pipeline))
